story: At 4:17 on a hazy Friday afternoon in Sumter Oaks, Gary is filing the rough edges off a speaker mount bracket in his workshop while Donna tucks stray flamingos behind the hedge so only three show from Magnolia Loop. Out on the street, Hal and Rosa are arranging tomorrow's plan, with Hal promising to be there at four for the table and Rosa agreeing to have the iced tea ready and a spot picked out. Rosa is also cheerfully inviting Donna to bring a cobbler, and the whole neighborhood seems pleased about the potluck to come.
events: Gary (gary workbench): Finish up the speaker mount bracket, file down the rough edges and test-fit it
Donna (donna flamingo flock): Count the flamingos and tuck any strays behind the hedge so only three show from the street

gary.thought_process: The cart wiring is secured and the speaker check is done. Paperwork is filed with Architectural Review, and I know L-01 means no exterior mods until approval, so the lights stay off. L-03 quiet hours are a non-issue at 4 PM, but I've kept things quiet anyway. I'm in the house, so the speaker mount bracket on the workbench is the thing I can keep working on without breaking any rules. Nobody's around, so I might as well get the bracket finished so it's ready the minute approval comes through. Keeps my hands busy too, which beats rattling around an empty house.

parameters.content: Finish up the speaker mount bracket, file down the rough edges and test-fit it

donna.thought_process: Hal and Rosa are sorting out the table and Saturday logistics, and I already told Hal about the flamingos and my cobbler last tick, so no need to repeat myself. The flock is mine and Hal's notice is still up, so I'll tend to it: do a quick count, confirm only three show from the street, and keep the peace before Saturday. Then I can head home and get ready for tomorrow's 7:45 pickup with Gary for court one.

parameters.content: Count the flamingos and tuck any strays behind the hedge so only three show from the street

hal.thought_process: Donna's down to three flamingos out front, so L-02 is settled and I can drop the notice I posted on the bulletin board. Rosa asked about carrying the long table tomorrow at four. I haven't answered that yet, and a supply sergeant doesn't leave a request hanging. Gary's paperwork is filed, Donna came into compliance, and Saturday dinner is on. Time to be a decent neighbor, so I'll confirm with Rosa and say a word to Donna.

parameters.content: I'll be there at four tomorrow for the table, Rosa. Have the tea cold and a spot picked out so we only carry the thing once.

rosa.thought_process: Hal and Donna are both confirmed for Saturday: Hal with cornbread at six and his own chair, Donna with peach cobbler. I already asked Hal about the long table last tick, and he answered about Saturday but not about four o'clock tomorrow, so I shouldn't repeat the whole question. A short, warm reply to both of them closes the loop and nails down the one detail still open. Then I can go work on the dinner prep.

parameters.content: Bring the chair, Hal, I'll make room for it. And Donna, cobbler too? Now I'm cooking for people who out-bake me. Hal, if tomorrow at four works for the table, just give me a nod and I'll have the tea ready.

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
